svg.title: Cleany v3 box: the named arm poses
svg.desc: Top and side views of the SO-101 at each named pose of the box pipeline, over an approximate layout of the tray and bins.
svg.text: Cleany v3 box: the named arm poses
Where each pose from config/poses.yaml puts the arm. The arm is exact (forward kinematics of the SO-101); the tray and bins are approximate, scaled from the v3 photo.
Dots: between the fingertips. Dashed arrows: the route of one cycle: home, hover (the pick
model lowers, grasps, lifts), transit, a bin, home. The arm is exact; the tray and bins
approximate. Side view: the arm's plane at pan 0 (the two bins share one dot position).
cm, from the arm base; z = 0 is the table
Folded up over the base, as low and compact as the arm goes, clear of
Every cycle starts and ends here. The
drop doors only open with the arm here.
14 cm ahead · +0 cm sideways · -1 cm up · gripper 70° down
pan 3 lift -104 elbow 98 wrist flex 77 roll -85 gripper 3
Above the tray, camera looking down
Over the middle of the tray, gripper pointing down, high enough that
the wrist camera sees the whole tray.
HOVER: the arm goes here after an item
is found; the pick model takes over from
22 cm ahead · -0 cm sideways · +12 cm up · gripper 76° down
pan 3 lift -23 elbow 8 wrist flex 92 roll -85 gripper 3
High above the tray, between the two bins
High above the middle of the tray, level with the gap between the
bins, higher than every wall and rim.
CARRY: every carried item passes here on
its way to a bin. The pick recorder lets
go of the item here, so it falls back
25 cm ahead · +1 cm sideways · +16 cm up · gripper 11° down
pan -0 lift -83 elbow 70 wrist flex 24 roll -85 gripper 3
Above the middle of the metal bin, on the arm's LEFT, fingertips above
the rim so the item falls in.
CARRY then RELEASE for metal items.
24 cm ahead · +18 cm sideways · +16 cm up · gripper 26° down
pan -40 lift -30 elbow 32 wrist flex 24 roll -85 gripper 3
Above the middle of the plastic bin, on the arm's RIGHT, fingertips
above the rim so the item falls in.
CARRY then RELEASE for plastic items.
24 cm ahead · -19 cm sideways · +16 cm up · gripper 26° down
pan 44 lift -30 elbow 32 wrist flex 24 roll -85 gripper 3
OPTIONAL: low on the tray, where an item lies
Straight down from hover, fingertips at the height of an item lying on
the tray floor, gripper pointing down.
Only the scripted grasp test (a fake
grasp, to try the pipeline on the arm
before a pick model exists): it goes
here and closes the gripper. Not needed
for the pipeline or for recording.
18 cm ahead · +2 cm sideways · -6 cm up · gripper 85° down
pan -3 lift 13 elbow 53 wrist flex 23 roll -85 gripper 53
